name: garlic broccoli
instructions:
Sautéed garlic broccoli, two ways. VARIANT A is the italian build; VARIANT B is the indian-spiced build (absorbed from the former indian-spiced-broccoli recipe). Both finish with lemon JUICE, not zest.

=== VARIANT A — ITALIAN (GARLIC + CHILI + FENNEL) ===

Broccoli in olive oil with garlic, red chili flakes, and fennel powder. Salt and black pepper. Lemon juice to finish.

=== VARIANT B — INDIAN SPICES ===

Same garlic-broccoli chassis with the indian spice stack instead: cumin, coriander, turmeric, garam masala, cardamom. Olive oil, garlic, salt. Lemon juice to finish.
notes:
Lemon juice, not zest — both variants.

=== MERGED (SEPTEMBER 2026) ===

The former indian-spiced-broccoli recipe was merged in as variant B — same dish, different spice stack, no reason for two files.
